name: error-turn-is-not-spoken-or-replayable
description: A turn that ends with an error appends an error entry naming the CLI's subtype and the result text, and leaves nothing for Replay Last Reply. A successful turn's result text is what Replay speaks.
reason: An error result is not an answer: reading it aloud as one, or replaying it later, would present a failure as Claude's reply.
source: AppState.handleHarnessEvent(.turnCompleted); DESIGN.md v1.0 (the spoken reply is the turn's result text)

script.reason: This one succeeds: its trimmed result text is the reply Replay speaks.

transcript.text:
